summary: Jump Camera Pipeline Testing Complete. Found and fixed critical bug: POST /api/jump/assessment was returning 500 Internal Server Error when athlete.weight was null. Fixed by changing `athlete.get('weight', 70)` to `athlete.get('weight') or 70`. All 15 backend API tests now pass. VBT/Jump Camera isolation verified. Critical frontend fix verified at line 578-585 (useEffect transitions to results on phase='review' regardless of metrics).

bug_fixed.original_code: body_mass_kg = athlete.get('weight', 70)  # Default 70kg if not set
bug_fixed.fixed_code: body_mass_kg = athlete.get('weight') or 70  # Default 70kg if not set or None
bug_fixed.reason: dict.get() with default value still returns None if key exists but value is None. Using `or` ensures fallback to 70 when weight is None.
bug_fixed.impact: POST /api/jump/assessment was returning 500 Internal Server Error for athletes without weight set
